request.subject: UNIT:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Change only the colours of the sails and pennants: both big red sails become deep crimson cloth, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, each with a thin gold-yellow border and one big gold-yellow cross in its middle; the red pennants become crimson with gold-yellow tips. Keep the pale wooden hull, the grey stone tower and rails, ship shape, size, the empty space at the left and right edges, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
